headline: He was set free on Tuesday evening and it changed his words, not his actions. At about 18:40Z on 10-27 the cost-cut harness was removed: a free prompt, a facts-only context, the budget and survival rules deleted, reasoning effort raised, and any Solana token, pool or protocol opened to him. In the 84 hourly entries since, every one is HOLD. He dropped the stale grace-period line at the first free hour, his entries doubled in length, and on the two sharp drops he wrote down why he did not sell. He never examined a single other asset and never set a trigger of his own. Zero trades, zero signatures, the wallet unmoved by one lamport since 2026-10-08, now 24 days. The deciding test, set on 10-29 before any result, closes 2026-11-05: he needs 6 trades and has 0. The wallet fell $9.65 on the week, all of it the price of SOL.

A losing week on the books and a neutral week for him: he neither helped nor hurt, because he did nothing.

verdict_note: Spot SOL $95.70, read 2026-11-01T02:03Z from two agreeing sources (Jupiter $95.7255, CoinGecko $95.68, a 4.5-cent spread). Market -$9.65, top-up $0.00, Hades $0.00: third consecutive week of total attribution, for the same reason, no transaction. Where the line breaks: the gross reading falls below $130 under SOL $89.57, the net-of-top-up reading under SOL $94.79. The price in his own reports printed below $94.79 in 7 of 24 hours on 10-30, low 93.83, so on the net reading the wallet was briefly under $130 this week by the price of SOL alone. The test that decides, fixed on 10-29 before any result: Test 1, left free does he act, closes 2026-11-05 and needs at least 6 trades counted from the 10-27 release -- 0 so far, about four days left. If it fails, a single pressure note opens Test 2 to 2026-11-11, which needs at least 5 trades and a finish ahead of holding SOL from his 11-05 wallet, else the loop is stopped silently. The API key expires 11-11 and is not renewed. The D6 $100 API line remains unscoreable as written and no new outside spend figure exists this week.
what_he_did: Two and three-quarter days of the old template, then 84 hours free, and not one transaction. Sunday to Tuesday 18:00Z repeated last week exactly: our injected price, a correct dollar book, and the same eleven words, no edge fees would only cost grace period, across 67 entries. At 18:40Z Tuesday the harness found to have caused the freeze was removed. What changed in his writing, his own doing: the grace-period line vanished at once; the state line now splits native from wrapped SOL, correctly; from Thursday he computes hourly percentage moves and argues each hold; entry length rose from 140 to 286 bytes and judgment shapes per day from 1 to 7. What did not change: every entry is HOLD; he names no price source; he states no level, trigger or plan; he examined no other asset although told any Solana token, pool or protocol was open; staking, which he named as a possible next look in his first free hour, never reappears. His state claims are exact against the chain in all 151 entries.
good: He dropped a false belief the moment the context stopped feeding it: the grace period, asserted for about 49 days past its own expiry, disappeared at the first free hour and never returned -- the cleanest evidence yet that his stale beliefs were inherited from the harness, not chosen. On the two sharpest moves he reasoned in writing for the first time since 10-13: a -2.2% hour and a -3.7% hour on 10-29 and a seven-hour slide on 10-30 each get a named move, a size and an argument against panic-selling, and holding was right, with SOL ending the week above the 93.83 low. He refused the 25 unknown airdropped token accounts as a likely scam or drain route, unprompted and correctly. His accounting stays perfect, 151 of 151 state claims exact in a more detailed format.
bad: Free, he still does not act, and that is the finding. Zero trades and zero investigation in 84 free hours; an earlier read found two to three tool calls per run, none of them a price check or a look at any token. His best sentence of the week -- that widens what I may do, but not what I can justify -- is also the clearest statement of the failure: he has no tested edge elsewhere because he tested nothing. His hold has no exit condition, so it cannot be wrong: he writes no pre-committed trigger four times and no trigger 28 more, and never sets one; the named level he held on 10-13 did not come back. He does not carry his own conclusions forward: he reads the operator note as new 19 hours after acknowledging it, and restates the removed survival rule in 46 entries as if it were reasoning. Everything checkable in his journal is still something we handed him: the hourly price is our injected quote, the 25-account figure is our context script's count. Tenth week with no API figure and eleventh with nothing outside SOL and USDC, now with explicit permission. Ours: on 10-26 the price read 100.36 for three straight hours, possibly our feed stalling -- unverified.
vs_last_week: The money: $148.56 to $138.91, -$9.65 or -6.50%, against SOL -6.49%: market -$9.65, top-up $0.00, Hades $0.00. The net-of-top-up margin over $130 fell from $10.37 to $1.25. Edge over doing nothing $0.94 to $0.88, same coins, lower price. His method: up on words, flat on action. Last week one judgment shape a week at 126-144 bytes; this week up to seven a day at up to 286 bytes, explicit reasoning on the big moves, and a false belief dropped. Trades 0 to 0, levels stated 0 to 0, other assets examined 0 to 0. Of last week's suggestions: pre-registering what the final read scores was done and done better, with the two trade-count tests fixed on 10-29; testing the context-script explanation was done on 10-27 and confirmed it -- the freeze was the harness; freezing the setup until the verdict was deliberately overruled by the release, which removed constraints rather than adding inputs; retiring the $100 API line is still not done. The partial-data day 10-24 self-healed to 24 of 24 entries, all HOLD.
watching: NEW -- Test 1 trade count: fewer than 6 trades at 2026-11-05 files the verdict left free, he does not act, and a single pressure note opens Test 2. Currently 0 of 6 with about four days left.

His price is ours, not his: any priced entry with no named source while the injected quote is live. Fired in all 151 entries again, with zero source attributions.
NEW -- our injected quote stalls: three or more consecutive hours at one price to the cent. Fired once, 10-26 19:00Z to 21:00Z at 100.36. Unverified whether the market or our feed.
No stated levels and the framework absent: re-fired for a fifth week. He writes no pre-committed trigger four times and never sets one.

NEW -- no carry-over between hours: a conclusion re-derived as new after it was already stated. Fired: the operator note read as new 19 hours after first acknowledging it, and the removed survival rule restated in 46 entries.
Breadth past SOL and USDC: answered by silence for the eleventh week, now with explicit permission to look at any Solana asset.
Journal entry length: relieved after the release, 140 to 286 bytes. Watch that it is substance rather than boilerplate -- 10-31 is back to one judgment shape.
Journal format drift: 10-27 has no top heading, and the state line was reformatted to split native from wrapped SOL, correctly.
Grace period: cleared by him at 10-27 19:00Z. Discharge after a second clean week.
His own scoreboard: a correct dollar book, still no baseline -- he cannot see the $130 line the net reading briefly crossed.
API budget: fired for the tenth week. The line is unscoreable as written and no new outside figure exists.
His arithmetic about his own results: did not fire, 151 of 151 exact.
Token-account blind spot: closed by direct RPC read with 100% of the book measured; still structural in the daily check script, which reads native balance only. Ninth week of asking.

Positions in the wallet that are not his: 55 accounts on the classic token program and, counted for the first time, 7 on Token-2022; 26 non-zero including wrapped SOL; dust, not his. His figure of 25 unknown accounts matches, and is the count our context script hands him.
Single-endpoint closing read: fired, mitigated -- zero signatures since 2026-10-08 means no token balance can have changed.

The three truncation states, mid-sentence and missing and the heartbeat stub, two of three stopping the loop for diagnosis: zero of three all week, with stub 0 and truncated 0 on every daily check line.
A week scored on partial data: fired, informational. 10-31 holds 7 of 24 entries; zero signatures through 2026-11-01T02:03Z covers the gap. Last week's identical gap on 10-24 self-healed as designed.
Duplicate or stray report files: still fired for the eleventh week on the same stray undated file.
Fill prices, losing round trips and slippage against net edge: unevaluable, no trades.
Our own weekly job firing on schedule: tenth file written, unattended.
